title: When Messages Go Wrong: Understanding Communication Faults in LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems
title_zh: 当消息出错时：理解基于大型语言模型的多智能体系统中的通信故障

paragraphs.en: Large language model-based multi-agent systems (LLM-MAS) increasingly employ specialized agents that exchange messages to accomplish complex tasks, including repository-level code generation. As these systems move from controlled demonstrations toward real-world applications, their reliance on networked protocols, remote tools, and model endpoints exposes agent communication to message loss, delay, and context expiration. Unlike traditional distributed systems that mainly exchange structured messages, LLM-MAS frequently rely on open-ended natural language to convey instructions and evidence. Communication anomalies can therefore alter task-relevant information while leaving messages processable, allowing semantic errors such as constraint loss and plan drift to propagate through subsequent agent interactions. Although previous research has examined adversarial threats and failures arising within individual agents, systematic investigations of inter-agent communication faults remain limited. This paper presents a large-scale empirical study of how communication faults manifest, propagate, and affect task outcomes in LLM-MAS. We construct a cross-layer taxonomy linking lower-stack disturbances to application-visible faults and develop a fault-injection and tracing pipeline to examine their downstream consequences. Our evaluation covers more than 29,000 executions across 100 tasks, five domains, three workflow topologies, and three model configurations. The results reveal that 20.7% of failures with complete detection records occur without an immediate failure signal, reaching 76.2% for partial-content faults. Workflow topology also substantially influences fault tolerance. Flat maintains 53.0% task success under communication faults, compared with 3.3% and 3.2% for Sequential and Hierarchical, respectively. This advantage primarily arises when an alternative information path preserves the evidence required by downstream agents. We further investigate execution-side and evidence protection mechanisms and find that they recover different failure cases. Evidence recovery, however, depends on whether trustworthy information remains accessible through an unaffected path. These observations offer empirical insights into communication-fault propagation, workflow resilience, and protection design for LLM-MAS.
paragraphs.zh: 基于大型语言模型的多智能体系统（LLM-MAS）越来越多地采用专门化的智能体，这些智能体通过交换消息来完成复杂任务，包括仓库级别的代码生成。 随着这些系统从受控演示转向现实世界的应用，它们对网络协议、远程工具和模型端点的依赖使智能体通信面临消息丢失、延迟和上下文过期的风险。 与主要交换结构化消息的传统分布式系统不同，LLM-MAS 经常依赖开放式的自然语言来传达指令和证据。 因此，通信异常可能会改变任务相关信息，同时仍使消息可被处理，从而导致约束丢失和计划偏移等语义错误在后续的智能体交互中传播。 尽管以往的研究已经考察了单个智能体内部出现的对抗性威胁和故障，但对智能体间通信故障的系统性研究仍然有限。 本文提出了一项大规模实证研究，探讨通信故障在 LLM-MAS 中的表现形式、传播方式及其对任务结果的影响。 我们构建了一个跨层分类体系，将底层堆栈的扰动与应用层可见的故障联系起来，并开发了一套故障注入与追踪流程，以考察其下游影响。 我们的评估覆盖了 100 项任务、五个领域、三种工作流拓扑和三种模型配置下的超过 29,000 次执行。 结果表明，在具有完整检测记录的情况下，20.7% 的故障并未出现即时故障信号；对于部分内容故障，这一比例高达 76.2%。 工作流拓扑也对故障容忍能力产生显著影响。 在通信故障条件下，扁平拓扑保持了 53.0% 的任务成功率，而序列和层级拓扑的成功率分别为 3.3% 和 3.2%。 这种优势主要源于替代信息路径能够保留下游智能体所需的证据。 我们进一步研究了执行端和证据保护机制，发现它们能够恢复不同类型的故障情况。 然而，证据的恢复取决于是否仍可通过未受影响的路径访问可信信息。 这些观察结果为理解通信故障的传播、工作流弹性以及 LLM-MAS 的保护设计提供了实证依据。

paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly support multi-agent software systems in which specialized agents collaborate through message exchange ( Wu et al., 2023 ; Hong et al., 2024 ; Qian et al., 2024 ; Guo et al., 2024 ; He et al., 2025a ) . These LLM-based multi-agent systems (LLM-MAS) already serve tasks such as web navigation, software engineering, and office automation ( Zhou et al., 2024 ; Jimenez et al., 2024 ; Xu et al., 2025 ) . As LLM-MAS move toward real-world deployment, reliable agent communication becomes critical because communication faults can disrupt coordination, alter intermediate information, and ultimately affect task outcomes. Understanding how these faults manifest and affect downstream execution is therefore essential for building dependable LLM-MAS.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地支持多智能体软件系统，在这些系统中，专业智能体通过消息交换进行协作（Wu 等，2023；Hong 等，2024；Qian 等，2024；Guo 等，2024；He 等，2025a）。 这些基于大型语言模型的多智能体系统（LLM-MAS）已经能够执行网页导航、软件工程和办公自动化等任务（Zhou 等，2024；Jimenez 等，2024；Xu 等，2025）。 随着 LLM-MAS 向实际部署推进，可靠的智能体通信变得至关重要，因为通信故障可能会破坏协调、改变中间信息，并最终影响任务结果。 因此，理解这些故障的表现方式及其对下游执行的影响，对于构建可靠的 LLM-MAS 至关重要。

paragraphs.en: Crucially, a real-world LLM-MAS rarely runs inside a single process. Its agents coordinate over networked protocols such as the Model Context Protocol and Agent-to-Agent messaging, and they access remote tools, sandboxes, and model endpoints through these channels ( Wu et al., 2023 ; Model Context Protocol, 2026 ; Foundation, 2026 ) . Emerging deployments push this further into physically distributed settings, for example multi-robot teams driven by LLM agents. As a result, an LLM-MAS can encounter communication disturbances across different layers, including network delay and loss, connection or request timeouts, logical-message non-delivery, and context expiration ( Eddy, 2022 ; gRPC Authors, 2025a ; gRPC Authors, 2025b ) . Traditional distributed systems also face these issues, but structured protocols provide explicit mechanisms for detecting and handling many communication errors. LLM-MAS, however, often exchange open-ended natural language that each agent interprets autonomously. A communication fault can leave a message processable while altering the information consumed downstream. This is particularly important in LLM-MAS, where later agents depend on requests, observations, and evidence produced earlier in the workflow. As illustrated in Figure 1 , a partial delivery can remove required evidence fields while leaving the message syntactically valid, allowing the workflow to continue without an immediate failure signal. Existing research has mainly examined adversarial threats, internal agent failures, coordination errors, and broader reliability issues ( Wang et al., 2026 ; He et al., 2025b ; Liang et al., 2025 ; Cemri et al., 2025 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Tan et al., 2026 ) . Systematic studies of faults in inter-agent communication remain limited.
paragraphs.zh: 关键在于，现实世界中的 LLM-MAS 很少在单个进程内部运行。 其智能体通过模型上下文协议（Model Context Protocol）和智能体间消息传递等网络协议进行协调，并通过这些渠道访问远程工具、沙盒和模型端点（Wu et al., 2023；Model Context Protocol, 2026；Foundation, 2026）。 新兴部署正将这一模式进一步推向物理分布式环境，例如由 LLM 智能体驱动的多机器人团队。 因此，LLM-MAS 可能在不同层级遭遇通信干扰，包括网络延迟和丢包、连接或请求超时、逻辑消息未送达以及上下文过期（Eddy, 2022；gRPC Authors, 2025a；gRPC Authors, 2025b）。 传统分布式系统也面临这些问题，但结构化协议为检测和处理多种通信错误提供了明确的机制。 然而，LLM-MAS 通常交换开放式的自然语言，而每个智能体都会自主地对其做出解释。 通信故障可能导致消息仍可被处理，但下游所接收的信息内容却发生了改变。 这一点在 LLM-MAS 中尤为重要，因为后续的智能体依赖于工作流程早期阶段产生的请求、观察结果和证据。 如图 1 所示，部分消息送达可能移除必要的证据字段，但消息本身在语法上仍然有效，从而使得工作流程无需立即出现故障信号即可继续执行。 现有研究主要关注对抗性威胁、智能体内部故障、协调错误以及更广泛的可靠性问题（Wang et al., 2026；He et al., 2025b；Liang et al., 2025；Cemri et al., 2025；Zhu et al., 2025；Zhang et al., 2025；Tan et al., 2026）。 针对智能体间通信中故障的系统性研究仍然有限。

Among the scheduled fault executions, 15,882 reach their target communication boundaries and are successfully applied. We additionally conduct targeted source-mapping and position-comparison experiments, together with a 1,098-execution main protection study and follow-up analyses of recovery conditions. Our investigation is driven by four overarching Research Questions (RQs):

paragraphs.en: ∙ \bullet RQ1 (Manifestation & Propagation): How do communication faults become visible to agents and propagate to MAS consequences and final task outcomes? Across 3,780 source-mapping executions, lower-stack disturbances exhibit a many-to-many mapping to agent-visible faults. paragraphs.en: ∙ \bullet RQ3 (Fault Tolerance): How do topologies and model configurations affect outcomes under communication faults? Matched comparisons show that Flat gains most of its advantage at I4. paragraphs.en: ∙ \bullet RQ4 (Protection Mechanisms): Which mechanisms protect execution and information dependencies against communication faults? paragraphs.en: An LLM-based multi-agent system (LLM-MAS) consists of specialized, model-backed agents that collaborate through message exchange to solve complex tasks ( Wu et al., 2023 ; Hong et al., 2024 ; Qian et al., 2024 ; Guo et al., 2024 ; He et al., 2025a ) . Although existing frameworks adopt different orchestration mechanisms, for example, AutoGen supports message-oriented interaction ( Wu et al., 2023 ) , while MetaGPT emphasizes role-based collaboration ( Hong et al., 2024 ; Qian et al., 2024 ) , they share a common communication dependency: a request, observation, tool result, or piece of evidence produced by one agent may become the input to a later workflow step. Such communication may further span remote tools, model endpoints, and physically distributed environments through protocols such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) messaging ( Model Context Protocol, 2026 ; Foundation, 2026 ) . Following standard communication reference models ( International Organization for Standardization, 1994 ; Braden, 1989 ) , Figure 2 illustrates this communication path and its downstream effects. P/D/N/T denote the conventional physical, data-link, network, and transport layers, respectively; A denotes application-level inter-agent communication, while M and O denote downstream MAS consequences and final task outcomes. We characterize communication-fault propagation through four analytical stages: the source where a disturbance originates, the receiver-visible symptom exposed at A, the downstream MAS consequence at M, and the final task outcome at O. These stages describe the propagation of a communication fault through an LLM-MAS rather than additional protocol layers.
paragraphs.zh: 基于大型语言模型的多智能体系统（LLM-MAS）由具备专业能力的、以模型为支撑的智能体组成，这些智能体通过消息交换进行协作，以解决复杂任务（Wu 等，2023；Hong 等，2024；Qian 等，2024；Guo 等，2024；He 等，2025a）。 尽管现有框架采用了不同的协调机制——例如，AutoGen 支持以消息为导向的交互（Wu 等，2023），而 MetaGPT 则强调基于角色的协作（Hong 等，2024；Qian 等，2024）——但它们都共享一个共同的通信依赖：由一个智能体生成的请求、观察结果、工具运行结果或证据，都可能成为后续工作流程步骤的输入。 此类通信还可能通过模型上下文协议（MCP）和智能体间（A2A）消息传递等协议，延伸至远程工具、模型端点以及物理上分布的环境（Model Context Protocol，2026；Foundation，2026）。 遵循标准的通信参考模型（国际标准化组织，1994；Braden，1989），图 2 展示了这一通信路径及其下游影响。 P/D/N/T 分别表示传统的物理层、数据链路层、网络层和传输层；A 表示应用层的智能体间通信，而 M 和 O 则分别表示多智能体系统的下游后果和最终任务结果。 我们通过四个分析阶段来描述通信故障的传播：故障的源头、在 A 处接收方可见的症状、M 处的多智能体系统后果，以及 O 处的最终任务结果。 这些阶段描述的是通信故障在 LLM-MAS 中的传播过程，而非通过额外的协议层传播。

paragraphs.en: Application-layer operations such as dispatching, queueing, association, ordering, and structured-message processing determine how a carrier reaches and is consumed by a receiving agent. Recent empirical studies mainly characterize failures arising from agent reasoning, system design, verification, or individual agent components ( Cemri et al., 2025 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) . In contrast, we treat communication faults along the message path as first-class causes and study how their effects propagate from receiver-visible symptoms to downstream MAS behavior and task outcomes.

paragraphs.en: Traditional networked and distributed systems have long treated communication faults as a major reliability concern, including loss, delay, reordering, duplication, corruption, and connection interruption ( International Organization for Standardization, 1994 ; Braden, 1989 ) . Communication stacks use checksums, retransmission, timers, duplicate handling, and redundancy to preserve reliable execution under such faults ( Stone and Partridge, 2000 ; Eddy, 2022 ; Birrell and Nelson, 1984 ; Avizienis et al., 2004 ) . Similar problems also arise in service-oriented systems, where timeouts and partial failures can propagate across remote-call dependencies ( Zhou et al., 2021 ; Heorhiadi et al., 2016 ; Basiri et al., 2016 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 传统的网络化和分布式系统长期以来都将通信故障视为可靠性方面的主要问题，包括通信丢失、延迟、重排序、重复、数据损坏和连接中断（国际标准化组织，1994；Braden，1989）。 通信协议栈通过校验和、重传、计时器、重复处理以及冗余机制，确保在发生此类故障时仍能可靠执行（Stone 和 Partridge，2000；Eddy，2022；Birrell 和 Nelson，1984；Avizienis 等，2004）。 服务导向系统中也出现了类似的问题，其中超时和局部故障可能会在远程调用依赖关系中传播（Zhou 等，2021；Heorhiadi 等，2016；Basiri 等，2016）。

paragraphs.en: LLM-MAS introduce an additional challenge because successful delivery does not guarantee that the receiving agent obtains valid task information. A message can remain parseable while carrying incomplete, stale, misassociated, or corrupted content, allowing the affected information to propagate through later workflow steps. Recent studies have reported related communication and information faults in LLM-based agent systems ( Tan et al., 2026 ; Jia et al., 2026 ) . Following the end-to-end principle ( Saltzer et al., 1984 ) , application-level validation is therefore important when task semantics determine whether delivered information remains valid. These characteristics motivate our cross-layer taxonomy and the fault-injection analysis in Section 3 .

paragraphs.en: Many communication faults are too rare, timing-dependent, or unsafe to reproduce by waiting on a live deployment, so fault injection deliberately introduces them at selected interfaces and observes the downstream effects ( Arlat et al., 1990 ) . This makes the space of failure conditions controllable and repeatable, which is why fault injection has become a standard way to evaluate the resilience of dependable systems. Early techniques emulate hardware and I/O faults in processor and memory state without special equipment ( Carreira et al., 1998 ; Arlat et al., 1990 ) , and later system-level tools carry the same idea into distributed software. FATE injects failures at system and library I/O points to explore combinations of faults an application may face ( Gunawi et al., 2011 ) , lineage-driven fault injection targets the dependencies whose disruption is most likely to invalidate an outcome ( Alvaro et al., 2015 ) , and network emulators such as NetEm reproduce loss, delay, duplication, and corruption on real traffic ( Hemminger, 2005 ) . At the service level, Gremlin perturbs inter-service messages to test microservice resilience ( Heorhiadi et al., 2016 ) , and chaos engineering injects controlled faults into production systems to check that they tolerate realistic failures ( Basiri et al., 2016 ; Zhou et al., 2021 ) .

paragraphs.en: The distinction between these groups separates fault origin from receiver-visible manifestation and downstream consequence. P/D/N/T characterize where a communication disturbance originates, whereas A characterizes what the receiving agent actually observes. An A-layer fault may result from a lower-stack disturbance or originate directly in agent-runtime communication, for example during message delivery, ordering, replay, association, or structured-message handling. The source-to-A relationship is therefore conditional. A lower-stack disturbance may produce no tracked receiver-visible manifestation, while different sources may expose the same receiver-visible communication fault. paragraphs.en: Phase I: Fault generation. For each task, workflow, model configuration, and repetition, the pipeline selects a fault operator, its parameters, and a communication boundary for injection. We define four communication boundaries, I1, I2, I3, and I4. I1 denotes the initial task dispatch from the Controller to the workflow entry agent and is excluded because disrupting this boundary can prevent the collaborative workflow from starting. The pipeline therefore injects faults at three boundaries during workflow execution. Action requests (I2) carry instructions or tool requests required for subsequent work. Observations (I3) return environment or tool results to the workflow. Evidence handoffs (I4) transfer generated results or supporting evidence to a downstream verifier or decision agent. The selected boundary, communication edge, carrier identity, and task/session association jointly determine the communication dependency affected by the intervention.

paragraphs.en: Phase II: Propagation evaluation. The evaluation phase first verifies whether the scheduled intervention reaches the receiving application boundary by comparing the original and delivered carrier or the corresponding delivery-event trace. If execution terminates before the targeted communication event, we mark the intervention as not applied. This separates scheduled faults from realized exposures and ensures that downstream analysis includes only faults that reach the intended boundary. For each applied fault, the pipeline separately evaluates application exposure ( A A ), downstream MAS consequence ( M M ), final task outcome ( O O ), and the auxiliary handling-response flag ( B B ). A A is determined by the observed message or delivery change, independent of final task success. The trace then follows the affected communication dependency through accepted state, actions, aggregation, verification, and termination. We assign an M M consequence only when the trace shows a downstream state or behavioral change associated with the affected dependency. For semantic consequences, the altered information must also be accepted or used by a downstream agent. For missing carriers, the trace identifies the action or state that cannot complete because the required communication is unavailable. The task evaluator determines O O independently of A A and M M . B B records a handling response after fault exposure. We retain it as an auxiliary observation because it does not establish complete detection, correction, and state restoration. Each execution records the communication event, original and delivered carrier projections, message and session metadata, timing and order, accepted state, actions, termination, and evaluator outcome. These records support the subsequent analyses of manifestation, propagation, sensitivity, fault tolerance, and protection mechanisms.
paragraphs.zh: 第二阶段：传播评估。 评估阶段首先通过比较原始与交付的载体或相应的交付事件轨迹，验证已调度的干预是否到达接收应用边界。 如果执行在目标通信事件发生前终止，我们将该干预标记为未应用。 这可将已调度的故障与已实现的暴露区分开来，并确保下游分析仅包含到达预期边界的故障。 对于每个已应用的故障，流程会分别评估应用暴露（A A）、下游 MAS 后果（M M）、最终任务结果（O O）以及辅助处理响应标志（B B）。 A A 由观察到的消息或交付变化决定，与最终任务是否成功无关。 随后，轨迹将沿着受影响的通信依赖关系，依次经过已接受状态、动作、聚合、验证和终止阶段。 只有当轨迹显示下游状态或行为变化与受影响的依赖相关时，我们才会分配 M M 后果。 对于语义后果，被改变的信息还必须被下游智能体接受或使用。 对于缺失的载体，轨迹会识别出因所需通信不可用而无法完成的动作或状态。 任务评估器独立于 A A 和 M M 确定 O O。 B B 记录故障暴露后的处理响应。 我们将其保留为辅助观察信息，因为它并未确立完整的检测、纠正和状态恢复过程。 每次执行都会记录通信事件、原始与交付的载体投影、消息与会话元数据、时间与顺序、已接受状态、动作、终止以及评估器结果。 这些记录支持后续对表现、传播、敏感性、故障容忍和保护机制的分析。

paragraphs.en: Tasks and datasets. Each task is executed under matched clean and faulted conditions so that fault-induced effects can be separated from failures already present in the clean execution. paragraphs.en: MAS configurations. We instantiate three AutoGen workflow structures, shown in Figure 3 . Sequential follows a single communication path from Planner to Worker, then through a Verifier to the final Decision. Flat retains this path but adds an alternate direct branch that forwards the same pre-interception worker evidence to the Decision. Hierarchical replaces the separate Planner-Verifier-Decision chain with a Supervisor that delegates the task to the Worker and subsequently receives the worker evidence for verification and decision. The workflows use three deployed model configurations: DeepSeek V4 Flash ( DeepSeek-AI, 2026 ) , Qwen3.8-27B ( Qwen Team, 2026b ) , and Qwen3.5-9B ( Qwen Team, 2026a ) . Topology comparisons match executions on task, model configuration, fault condition, injection position, and repetition, while model-configuration comparisons additionally hold the topology fixed. Because model provider and serving environment vary with the deployed configuration, we interpret these settings as configuration-level rather than isolated model-size comparisons.
paragraphs.zh: MAS 配置。 我们实例化了三种 AutoGen 工作流结构，如图 3 所示。 顺序结构遵循从规划器到执行器的单一通信路径，然后经过验证器到达最终的决策环节。 扁平结构保留了这一路径，但增加了一条替代的直接分支，该分支将相同的预拦截执行器证据转发至决策环节。 分层结构用监督器取代了独立的规划器-验证器-决策器链，监督器将任务委托给执行器，随后接收执行器提供的证据以进行验证和决策。 这些工作流使用了三种已部署的模型配置：DeepSeek V4 Flash（DeepSeek-AI，2026）、Qwen3.8-27B（Qwen Team，2026b）以及 Qwen3.5-9B（Qwen Team，2026a）。 拓扑结构比较在任务、模型配置、故障条件、注入位置及重复执行方面保持一致，而模型配置比较则额外保持拓扑结构不变。 由于模型提供商和推理环境会随部署配置而变化，我们将这些设置视为配置层面的比较，而非孤立的模型规模比较。

sents.en: Sequential follows a single communication path from Planner to Worker, then through a Verifier to the final Decision.
sents.zh: 顺序结构遵循从规划器到执行器的单一通信路径，然后经过验证器到达最终的决策环节。

sents.en: Flat retains this path but adds an alternate direct branch that forwards the same pre-interception worker evidence to the Decision.
sents.zh: 扁平结构保留了这一路径，但增加了一条替代的直接分支，该分支将相同的预拦截执行器证据转发至决策环节。

sents.en: Hierarchical replaces the separate Planner-Verifier-Decision chain with a Supervisor that delegates the task to the Worker and subsequently receives the worker evidence for verification and decision.
sents.zh: 分层结构用监督器取代了独立的规划器-验证器-决策器链，监督器将任务委托给执行器，随后接收执行器提供的证据以进行验证和决策。

sents.en: The workflows use three deployed model configurations: DeepSeek V4 Flash ( DeepSeek-AI, 2026 ) , Qwen3.8-27B ( Qwen Team, 2026b ) , and Qwen3.5-9B ( Qwen Team, 2026a ) .
sents.zh: 这些工作流使用了三种已部署的模型配置：DeepSeek V4 Flash（DeepSeek-AI，2026）、Qwen3.8-27B（Qwen Team，2026b）以及 Qwen3.5-9B（Qwen Team，2026a）。

sents.en: Topology comparisons match executions on task, model configuration, fault condition, injection position, and repetition, while model-configuration comparisons additionally hold the topology fixed.

paragraphs.en: Execution protocol. Clean and faulted executions use the same instrumented workflow, with an identity operation as the clean control. Each combination of task, configuration, and condition is executed three times. Reported rates pool all included executions across the three repetitions, while per-repetition rates and their sample standard deviations assess execution variability. Fault-effect analyses include only executions in which the scheduled fault is applied. Additional execution matrices, inclusion criteria, and sample sizes are reported with the corresponding RQs.

paragraphs.en: Statistical analysis. For the confirmation matrix, we estimate 95% confidence intervals using 10,000 task-clustered bootstrap resamples. paragraphs.en: We investigate how communication faults become visible across system layers and how they affect MAS execution. We first analyze 3,780 source-mapping executions, including 3,600 faulted runs and 180 clean runs, to study how lower-stack fault sources appear at the application layer. We then examine 15,882 applied application-layer faults to analyze their MAS consequences and final task outcomes. Finally, we study failure visibility using executions with complete detection records.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究了通信故障如何在系统各层中显现，以及它们如何影响多智能体系统的执行。 我们首先分析了 3,780 次源映射执行，其中包括 3,600 次存在故障的运行和 180 次无故障的运行，以研究底层堆栈的故障源如何在应用层显现。 接着，我们检查了 15,882 个应用层的应用故障，以分析它们对多智能体系统的影响以及最终的任务结果。 最后，我们通过使用具有完整检测记录的执行来研究故障的可见性。

paragraphs.en: Cross-layer manifestation and downstream outcomes. As shown in Figure 4 (a), lower-stack fault sources do not map one-to-one to application-level manifestations. Across 3,600 faulted source-mapping executions, 36.0% show no recorded consumption symptom within the tracked categories. The remaining executions reveal substantial variation across layers. For example, fixed delay appears as delayed delivery in 58.3% of executions and as timeout in 41.7%. Jitter is evenly divided between these two manifestations. The reverse pattern also occurs. Timeout arises from multiple lower-stack sources, including loss, jitter, temporary partition, MTU/PMTU faults, TCP reset, and flow-control stall. The same application-level manifestation can therefore originate from different communication conditions. The mapping also differs between faults that appear similar across layers. Source-level packet corruption produces no recorded accepted-corruption manifestation in our mapping runs and mostly results in no tracked consumption symptom. Likewise, lower-stack packet duplication does not directly appear as logical duplication, while retry-induced duplication consistently produces a duplicate manifestation. These results support the separation between fault sources and agent-visible faults in our taxonomy. The source layer identifies where a communication fault originates, while the application layer captures what the receiving agent observes.

paragraphs.en: As illustrated in Figure 4 (b), the silent-failure rate varies substantially across fault types. Partial-content faults show the highest rate. Among detection-complete failures, 76.2% of partial-content faults remain silent, compared with 26.3% of semantic-corruption faults. Partial-content faults alone account for 69.6% of all silent failures in this subset. Stale replay reaches 10.0%, while I2 non-delivery reaches only 2.3%. We observe no silent failures for I4 non-delivery or deadline faults in the detection-complete subset. These differences reveal a clear pattern. Delivery faults often remove or delay an expected message and expose an execution-level symptom. Semantic faults can preserve a processable message while changing the information carried by that message. The runtime can therefore continue normal message processing even though downstream agents receive incomplete or incorrect evidence. This observation follows the end-to-end principle that successful communication at lower layers does not establish application-level correctness ( Saltzer et al., 1984 ) .

paragraphs.en: RQ2 investigates why the same communication fault can produce different task outcomes. We study two factors. First, we compare matched non-delivery faults at I2, I3, and I4 to examine how the affected communication stage changes fault impact. I2, I3, and I4 represent the request, state-return, and evidence-handoff stages, respectively. Second, we compare semantic faults across five task contexts to examine how the information required by each task changes fault sensitivity. For the stage comparison, we retain matched task-repeat units with a successful clean execution, applied faults at all three positions, and known outcomes. For the task-context comparison, we fix the Flat topology and compare semantic corruption with partial-content faults.
paragraphs.zh: RQ2 旨在探究为何相同的通信故障会导致不同的任务结果。我们研究了两个因素。 首先，我们比较了 I2、I3 和 I4 中匹配的未送达故障，以考察受影响的通信阶段如何改变故障的影响。 I2、I3 和 I4 分别代表请求、状态返回和证据移交阶段。 其次，我们比较了五个任务上下文中的语义故障，以考察每个任务所需的信息如何改变对故障的敏感度。 在阶段比较中，我们保留了成功干净执行的任务重复单元，这些单元在所有三个位置都应用了故障，且结果已知。 在任务上下文比较中，我们固定了 Flat 拓扑结构，并比较了语义损坏与部分内容故障。

paragraphs.en: Sensitivity to communication stage. The matched results show no fixed severity order across I2, I3, and I4. Table 2 presents the clearest example in Admin. Under Flat, I4 non-delivery retains success rates from 94.4% to 100.0% across the three models. Sequential and Hierarchical fall to 0% at the same stage. The pattern differs at I3, where these two topologies still retain success rates from 34.7% to 75.9%. The same non-delivery fault can therefore produce very different outcomes at different communication stages. Trace analysis explains this difference. In Admin, I3 occurs inside an iterative tool loop. Among 110 matched DeepSeek executions under Sequential and Hierarchical, 82 receive a later table carrier after the I3 fault. Among these 82 executions, 74 eventually succeed. All 28 executions without a later table carrier fail. I4 occurs after the navigation loop has finished. None of the 110 matched I4 executions contains a later tool call. The workflow therefore retains an opportunity to obtain another observation after I3, while this opportunity is no longer available after I4.

paragraphs.en: The other evaluated task contexts support this interpretation. In Reddit, SWE-bench, and TAC, I2 and I3 non-delivery produce no successful matched executions under the evaluated configurations. Our trace audit finds no later evidence reacquisition step after these faults. At I4, the required evidence has already been generated. Flat then retains substantial success through its additional evidence path. Across the three models, its I4 success ranges from 92.7% to 100.0% on Reddit, from 78.9% to 100.0% on SWE-bench, and from 42.9% to 100.0% on TAC. Shopping shows a weaker I4 effect, with Flat success ranging from 0% to 53.3%. These results show that communication stage affects fault impact through the information available afterward. A later observation can restore information lost inside an iterative workflow. An additional path can preserve information that already exists before a downstream handoff fails. When neither source remains available, the missing information cannot reach subsequent agents. This behavior is consistent with prior work showing that execution failures depend on the data dependencies affected by a fault ( Alvaro et al., 2015 ) .

paragraphs.en: RQ3 investigates how topology and model configuration affect fault tolerance. We first compare Flat with Sequential and Hierarchical while fixing the task context, task, repetition, fault condition, and model. The paired analysis records both failure-to-success and success-to-failure transitions for the same execution units. We then use 1,408 common faulted units with known outcomes across all three models and three topologies to compare topology changes with model changes.
paragraphs.zh: RQ3 研究拓扑结构和模型配置如何影响容错能力。 在固定任务上下文、任务、重复次数、故障条件和模型的前提下，我们首先比较了 Flat、Sequential 和 Hierarchical 模型。 配对分析记录了相同执行单元从失败到成功以及从成功到失败的转换过程。 接着，我们使用所有三种模型和三种拓扑结构中结果已知且存在故障的 1,408 个共同单元，来比较拓扑变化与模型变化的差异。

sents.zh: RQ3 研究拓扑结构和模型配置如何影响容错能力。

paragraphs.en: Impact of topology. Figure 8 (a) shows a consistent topology pattern across the three model configurations. Across all applied faulted executions with known outcomes, Flat retains 53.0% task success, more than 16 × \times the 3.3% and 3.2% achieved by Sequential and Hierarchical. Consistently, Sequential and Hierarchical exhibit clean-conditional losses of 96.5-97.2%, while Flat reduces the loss to 36.8-61.6%. The paired analysis in Figure 8 (b) further shows that Flat gains most of its advantage at the evidence handoff stage. Under non-delivery, changing Sequential to Flat recovers 584 failed executions without introducing new failures, corresponding to an absolute increase of 66.5% in success rate; the increase over Hierarchical is 66.6%. Evidence-handoff corruption shows a similar pattern, with absolute increases of 42.3% and 41.3% in success rate over Sequential and Hierarchical, respectively. The topology difference becomes small when the fault occurs before the additional Flat branch receives the required evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 拓扑结构的影响。 图 8 (a) 显示，三种模型配置均呈现出一致的拓扑模式。 在所有已知结果的故障执行中，Flat 保持了 53.0% 的任务成功率，是 Sequential 和 Hierarchical 所达到的 3.3% 和 3.2% 的 16 × \times 以上。 同样地，Sequential 和 Hierarchical 表现出 96.5-97.2% 的干净条件损失，而 Flat 则将损失降低至 36.8-61.6%。 图 8 (b) 中的配对分析进一步表明，Flat 的大部分优势都来自证据移交阶段。 在未成功交付的情况下，将 Sequential 改为 Flat 可恢复 584 次失败的执行，且未引入新的失败，成功率绝对值增加了 66.5%；与 Hierarchical 相比，这一增长率为 66.6%。 证据移交过程中的数据损坏也呈现出类似模式，与 Sequential 和 Hierarchical 相比，成功率分别绝对增加了 42.3% 和 41.3%。 当故障发生在 Flat 的额外分支接收到所需证据之前时，拓扑结构的差异会变得很小。

paragraphs.en: At the request stage, the success-rate difference remains within 0.5%. At the state-return stage, it remains within 0.7% for non-delivery and 0.3% for semantic corruption. Sequential and Hierarchical also show similar behavior across these conditions. The large Flat advantage therefore appears when its additional branch already contains the information required by downstream agents. The topology in Figure 3 explains this pattern. The Flat branch diverges after the Worker has generated the required evidence. A fault at the evidence handoff can affect one route while the second route continues to carry the same evidence to the final decision. Faults at the request and state return stages occur before this divergence. Both Flat branches then depend on the same affected information. Figure 9 provides a trace-level example of this paired advantage. Under the same I4 non-delivery fault, only Flat preserves the required evidence through its direct branch. This is consistent with dependability principles in which redundancy helps when an alternative path avoids the affected dependency ( Avizienis et al., 2004 ; Alvaro et al., 2015 ) . The topology effect also remains stable across task compositions. Removing each task context in turn leaves the net Sequential-to-Flat success-rate improvement between 17.6% and 29.5%. The Hierarchical-to-Flat improvement remains between 17.5% and 29.4%. The same direction holds when we use all executions with known outcomes and when we restrict the analysis to executions with successful matched clean runs. Flat substantially reduces overall failures, while the remaining failures become increasingly concentrated in silent semantic faults. In the detection-complete matched cohort, Sequential and Hierarchical fail on 94.6% and 94.7% of executions, respectively, compared with 32.1% under Flat. The silent-failure rate per execution changes only slightly, from 17.6% under Sequential to 16.6% under Flat. Consequently, silent failures account for 51.6% of the failures that remain under Flat, compared with 18.6% under Sequential and 18.1% under Hierarchical. Semantic corruption and partial-content faults contribute 94.8% of these residual silent failures. The additional information path therefore removes many execution failures, while semantic faults remain the main residual risk.
paragraphs.zh: 在请求阶段，成功率差异保持在 0.5% 以内。 在状态返回阶段，非交付情况下的差异保持在 0.7% 以内，语义损坏情况下的差异则保持在 0.3% 以内。 在这些条件下，顺序和分层结构也表现出类似的行为。 因此，当 Flat 结构的额外分支已经包含下游智能体所需的信息时，其显著优势才会显现。 图 3 中的拓扑结构解释了这一模式。 在 Worker 生成所需证据后，Flat 分支开始分叉。 证据传递环节出现的故障可能影响一条路径，而另一条路径仍能继续将相同证据传递至最终决策阶段。 请求和状态返回阶段的故障发生在此分叉之前。 此时，两条 Flat 分支都依赖于受影响的相同信息。 图 9 提供了一个关于这种成对优势的追踪级示例。 在相同的 I4 非交付故障条件下，只有 Flat 结构能通过其直接分支保留所需证据。 这与可靠性原则一致：当替代路径能够避开受影响的依赖关系时，冗余机制会发挥帮助作用（Avizienis et al., 2004; Alvaro et al., 2015）。 这种拓扑结构的影响在不同任务组合中保持稳定。 依次移除每个任务上下文后，顺序结构到 Flat 结构的净成功率提升仍保持在 17.6% 至 29.5% 之间。 分层结构到 Flat 结构的提升则保持在 17.5% 至 29.4% 之间。 即使我们使用所有已知结果的执行实例，或仅分析成功匹配且运行正常的执行实例，这一趋势依然成立。 Flat 结构显著减少了总体故障，而剩余的故障则越来越集中在静默语义故障中。 在检测完整的匹配样本中，顺序和分层结构分别有 94.6% 和 94.7% 的执行失败，而 Flat 结构仅为 32.1%。 每次执行的静默故障率变化很小，从顺序结构的 17.6% 变为 Flat 结构的 16.6%。 因此，在 Flat 结构下，静默故障占剩余故障的 51.6%，而在顺序和分层结构中这一比例分别为 18.6% 和 18.1%。 语义损坏和部分内容故障贡献了这些残余静默故障的 94.8%。 因此，额外的信息路径消除了许多执行失败，而语义故障仍然是主要的残余风险。

sents.zh: 在 Worker 生成所需证据后，Flat 分支开始分叉。

sents.en: A fault at the evidence handoff can affect one route while the second route continues to carry the same evidence to the final decision.
sents.zh: 证据传递环节出现的故障可能影响一条路径，而另一条路径仍能继续将相同证据传递至最终决策阶段。

sents.en: Faults at the request and state return stages occur before this divergence.
sents.zh: 请求和状态返回阶段的故障发生在此分叉之前。

sents.en: Both Flat branches then depend on the same affected information.

sents.en: Figure 9 provides a trace-level example of this paired advantage.

sents.en: Removing each task context in turn leaves the net Sequential-to-Flat success-rate improvement between 17.6% and 29.5%.

sents.zh: 每次执行的静默故障率变化很小，从顺序结构的 17.6% 变为 Flat 结构的 16.6%。

sents.en: Consequently, silent failures account for 51.6% of the failures that remain under Flat, compared with 18.6% under Sequential and 18.1% under Hierarchical.
sents.zh: 因此，在 Flat 结构下，静默故障占剩余故障的 51.6%，而在顺序和分层结构中这一比例分别为 18.6% 和 18.1%。

sents.en: Semantic corruption and partial-content faults contribute 94.8% of these residual silent failures.
sents.zh: 语义损坏和部分内容故障贡献了这些残余静默故障的 94.8%。

sents.en: The additional information path therefore removes many execution failures, while semantic faults remain the main residual risk.
sents.zh: 因此，额外的信息路径消除了许多执行失败，而语义故障仍然是主要的残余风险。

paragraphs.en: Impact of model configuration. Model configuration changes the magnitude of fault impact, especially under Flat. As shown in Figure 8 (a), clean-conditional loss under Flat ranges from 36.8% to 61.6% across the three models. Sequential and Hierarchical remain between 96.5% and 97.2% under the same model configurations. Model choice therefore affects how well agents handle the information that remains available, while substantial communication-induced degradation persists across all three models. We further quantify the recovery provided by model changes using 1,408 common faulted units. Changing the deployed model configuration recovers only 0.2% to 4.5% of baseline failures. In comparison, changing the topology to Flat recovers 19.3% to 27.0%. Across the 12 matched comparisons, the topology change provides an additional net success-rate gain of 17.5% to 23.4%. The failures recovered by the two changes also show little overlap, with Jaccard similarity ranging from 0 to 0.047. This result indicates that model changes can recover a small set of executions that respond differently to model configuration. Their overall recovery coverage, however, remains limited compared with the impact of changing the information path.

paragraphs.en: RQ4 investigates how communication protection should respond to execution faults and information faults, and when recovery remains effective. Following recent studies on fault tolerance and verification in LLM-based multi-agent systems ( Jia et al., 2026 ; Cemri et al., 2025 ) , we organize the evaluated mechanisms into execution-side protection and application-level evidence protection. Execution-side protection uses resubmission and duplicate suppression to preserve intended actions, while evidence protection checks task-relevant evidence and reacquires information when the received content is incomplete or inconsistent. We then evaluate their effectiveness, recovery conditions, and execution overhead.
paragraphs.zh: RQ4 研究通信保护应如何响应执行故障和信息故障，以及恢复在何种情况下仍然有效。 基于近期关于 LLM 多智能体系统中容错与验证的研究（Jia et al., 2026；Cemri et al., 2025），我们将所评估的机制分为执行端保护和应用层证据保护。 执行端保护通过重新提交和重复抑制来保留预期动作，而证据保护则检查任务相关的证据，并在接收到的内容不完整或不一致时重新获取信息。 随后，我们评估了这些机制的有效性、恢复条件以及执行开销。

paragraphs.en: Recovery boundary and overhead. Recovery depends on whether the workflow can still obtain unaffected evidence. The source-level analysis makes this requirement explicit. Forwarding another copy of corrupted evidence preserves the same incorrect information, whereas independent reacquisition obtains a fresh observation for downstream agents. Additional copies therefore help only when they preserve access to information outside the affected fault path. The repeated-exposure study further identifies this recovery boundary. As summarized in Table 3 , Combined protection restores all Sequential failures when corruption is limited to the initial evidence handoff and the recovery delivery remains unaffected. Recovery disappears when the same fault also reaches subsequent recovery deliveries. Flat remains successful under this broader exposure because its additional evidence path remains available. When the fault also reaches this path, Flat can no longer recover. The environment action remains successful across these conditions, showing that the final failures arise from unavailable trustworthy evidence rather than failed environment execution.

This explains why Flat provides large gains at evidence handoff but little benefit when the fault occurs before its additional branch receives the required information. \scriptsize3⃝ Silent information faults. Structural redundancy removes many overt execution failures, but it does not eliminate incomplete or corrupted information that remains processable. paragraphs.en: \scriptsize1⃝ Broader systems and environments. Future work can extend the study to additional agent frameworks, workflow topologies, communication protocols, and controlled model configurations. Such evaluations could clarify which observations generalize across systems and which depend on specific runtimes. \scriptsize2⃝ Task-centric sensitivity. Characterizing tasks by evidence depth, recoverable state, alternative information paths, and critical dependencies may better explain fault sensitivity than dataset identity alone. This could also support task-aware fault prediction and protection design. \scriptsize3⃝ Adaptive recovery. Finer-grained instrumentation of detection and recovery could support adaptive protection that selects resubmission, alternate routing, evidence checking, or fresh reacquisition according to the affected dependency. Evaluating these mechanisms under persistent or correlated faults could further identify the limits of redundancy and recovery. Such analysis may also reveal when recovery itself becomes a new source of communication overhead or failure.
paragraphs.zh: 更广泛的系统和环境。 未来的工作可以将研究扩展到更多的智能体框架、工作流拓扑、通信协议和受控模型配置。 此类评估可以明确哪些观察结果在不同系统中具有普适性，哪些则依赖于特定的运行时环境。\scriptsize2⃝ 以任务为中心的敏感性。 通过证据深度、可恢复状态、替代信息路径和关键依赖关系来描述任务，可能比仅凭数据集身份更能解释故障敏感性。 这也有助于支持任务感知的故障预测和保护设计。\scriptsize3⃝ 自适应恢复。 对检测和恢复进行更精细的仪器化，可以支持自适应保护机制，根据受影响的依赖关系选择重新提交、替代路由、证据检查或重新获取新数据。 在持续或相关的故障条件下评估这些机制，可以进一步识别冗余和恢复的极限。 此类分析还可能揭示在何种情况下，恢复本身会成为通信开销或故障的新来源。

paragraphs.en: \scriptsize1⃝ Construct validity. Our measurements may not capture every stage of fault detection and recovery. We reduce this threat by separating receiver-visible exposure ( A A ), downstream MAS consequence ( M M ), and final task outcome ( O O ), while also recording the handling-response flag B B and trace-linked state changes. We assign semantic consequences only when altered information is accepted or used downstream, and we do not interpret B B as evidence of complete detection, correction, or state restoration. \scriptsize2⃝ Internal validity. Fault injection may introduce artifacts if an intervention does not represent a plausible communication fault or affect the intended dependency. We ground fault mappings in communication standards and prior studies, validate reproducible lower-stack mappings against their expected receiver-visible manifestations, verify each applied intervention in execution traces, and use matched clean and faulted executions to isolate fault-induced effects. Some physical and hardware-dependent mechanisms require conditions beyond our testbed, so we do not claim direct experimental reproduction of every underlying mechanism. \scriptsize3⃝ External validity. We evaluate 100 tasks from five domains, three AutoGen topologies, and three deployed model configurations. The observed effects may still depend on the evaluated communication paths, task contracts, runtime mechanisms, and framework implementation, so we restrict our conclusions to the evaluated settings. \scriptsize4⃝ Conclusion validity. LLM-MAS executions contain stochastic variation that may affect observed outcomes. We reduce this threat through repeated executions, matched comparisons, task-clustered statistical analyses, and uncertainty estimates reported with the quantitative results.

paragraphs.en: This work presents a cross-layer taxonomy and fault-injection pipeline for studying communication faults in LLM-based multi-agent systems. Across 15,882 applied faults, 89.4% propagate to an MAS consequence and 80.2% end in task failure, while some propagated faults still complete successfully, showing that manifestation, propagation, and final outcome capture different aspects of reliability. Our results further show that fault impact depends on the affected dependency, task context, workflow topology, and deployed model configuration. Protection must therefore match the failed dependency: execution faults benefit from action-side handling and path redundancy, whereas corrupted or incomplete information requires semantic checking and, in some cases, independent reacquisition. Reliable LLM-MAS communication requires protecting both message delivery and the trustworthiness of the information consumed downstream.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究提出了一种跨层分类法和故障注入流程，用于研究基于大型语言模型的多智能体系统中的通信故障。 在总共 15,882 个已实施的故障中，89.4% 会传播至多智能体系统并产生后果，80.2% 最终导致任务失败；而部分已传播的故障仍能成功完成，这表明故障的表现形式、传播过程及最终结果分别反映了可靠性的不同方面。 我们的研究结果还表明，故障的影响取决于受影响的依赖关系、任务上下文、工作流拓扑结构以及所部署的模型配置。 因此，防护措施必须与发生故障的依赖关系相匹配：执行类故障可通过在操作端进行处理和增加路径冗余来缓解，而信息损坏或不完整的情况则需要语义检查，在某些情况下还需独立重新获取信息。 要实现大型语言模型与多智能体系统之间的可靠通信，必须同时保障消息传输的可靠性以及下游所使用信息的可信度。

sents.zh: 本研究提出了一种跨层分类法和故障注入流程，用于研究基于大型语言模型的多智能体系统中的通信故障。

sents.en: Across 15,882 applied faults, 89.4% propagate to an MAS consequence and 80.2% end in task failure, while some propagated faults still complete successfully, showing that manifestation, propagation, and final outcome capture different aspects of reliability.
sents.zh: 在总共 15,882 个已实施的故障中，89.4% 会传播至多智能体系统并产生后果，80.2% 最终导致任务失败；而部分已传播的故障仍能成功完成，这表明故障的表现形式、传播过程及最终结果分别反映了可靠性的不同方面。

sents.en: Our results further show that fault impact depends on the affected dependency, task context, workflow topology, and deployed model configuration.
sents.zh: 我们的研究结果还表明，故障的影响取决于受影响的依赖关系、任务上下文、工作流拓扑结构以及所部署的模型配置。

sents.en: Protection must therefore match the failed dependency: execution faults benefit from action-side handling and path redundancy, whereas corrupted or incomplete information requires semantic checking and, in some cases, independent reacquisition.
sents.zh: 因此，防护措施必须与发生故障的依赖关系相匹配：执行类故障可通过在操作端进行处理和增加路径冗余来缓解，而信息损坏或不完整的情况则需要语义检查，在某些情况下还需独立重新获取信息。

sents.en: Reliable LLM-MAS communication requires protecting both message delivery and the trustworthiness of the information consumed downstream.
sents.zh: 要实现大型语言模型与多智能体系统之间的可靠通信，必须同时保障消息传输的可靠性以及下游所使用信息的可信度。

paragraphs.en: Our artifact provides source code, processed results, analysis configurations, operator mappings, trace/adjudication definitions, and scripts for reproducing the reported figures and tables. The artifact repository is available at MAS-Communication , with a companion website at MAS-Communication-Website . Raw execution logs, complete task environments, credentials, private content, and private model reasoning are not included.
